title: Darlene Nolen Becomes Bride Of Robert Blakey
text:
Darlene Nolen Becomes Bride Of Robert Blakey

LEONARD — Miss Patresa Darlene Nolen, daughter of Mr. and Mrs. O. H. Nolen Jr. of Leonard, and Robert Derrell Blakey, son of Rev. and Mrs. Robert L. Blakey of Wylie, were united in marriage recently in the Pentecostal Church of Jesus Christ.

Rev. Blakey, father of the bridegroom, performed the double ring ceremony before an altar of candles, flanked by two spiral candelabra and tall white baskets filled with white mums. Gladiolus, pink roses and a kneeling bench completed the altar decor.

Mrs. Charlotte Pitts, organist of Plano, accompanied Miss Bettye Blakey of Wylie, as she sang, "I Love You Because" and "Wedding Prayer."

Mr. Nolen presented his daughter in marriage. She wore a floor length gown styled with winsome Victorian charm. Delicate acetate and nylon lace adorned the empire bodice of nylon sheer over acetate taffeta. The gown featured a graceful A-line skirt. The bodice was fashioned with a demure stand-up collar and Juliet sleeves. Her lace bordered, detachable, chapel length train of nylon sheer, flowed from a ribbon at the waist.

A half halo of acetate and nylon lace petals accented with pearls and crystal held the three tiered bouffant elbow length veil of nylon tulle.

The bride carried a Victorian cluster of white roses and miniature carnations with satin streamers, tied in love knots.

Miss Nolen presented her mother with a long stem pink rose as she walked to the alter and presented the bridegroom's mother a rose as she left, following the ceremony.

Miss Belinda Pitts of Van Alstyne, was maid of honor and Miss Shirley Nolen of Leonard was bridesmaid. They wore pink floral brocade empire style gowns, accented with hot pink velvet ribbon. Their headpieces were of matching ribbon and pink carnations. Each carried a single pink rose with satin streamers. Daretha Nolen, sister of the bride, was flower girl.

James Blakey of Garland served as best man and Larry Ratliff of Bentonville, Ark., was groomsman. Ricky Flanagan of Leonard was ring bearer. Larry Blakey of Marshall and Benny Blakey of Wylie seated the guests. Candlelighters were Dewain and Darvin Nolen, brothers of the bride and Benny Blakey of Wylie.

A reception was held in the fellowship hall of the church, which was decorated in pink and white. White lanterns enhanced the room.

The bride's table was laid with white lace over pink and centered with three candles, surrounded by white carnations. A four tiered cake decorated with pink roses and white swans, topped with three pink satin bells, and punch were served by Mrs. Delores Hutchins and Miss Karolyn McCord, both of Leonard. Crystal appointments completed the table decorations.

Miss Marilyn Johnson served at the bridegroom's table, which was laid with an off-white lace cloth and held a chocolate cake and coffee service.

Miss Roberto Grogan of Leonard registered the guests.

The bride is a graduate of Leonard High School and the bridegroom is a graduate of Wylie High School and attended Texas Bible College, Houston. They will be at home in Plano.
